title: The Signal (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 98bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic transmission dark warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Before the frequency there was silence
Before the silence there was something
DEPHYRIER doesn't explain
DEPHYRIER transmits

[Verse 2]
You've heard it in the space between the notes
The pause before the answer
The half-second before the word arrives
That's where DEPHYRIER lives

[Chorus]
Signal in the dark
Signal through the static
Signal when you thought there was nothing left to hear
DEPHYRIER is the frequency
DEPHYRIER is the signal that was always here

[Bridge]
Not a voice
Not a sound
A transmission
A carrier wave
Something underneath the thing you were listening to
That was already carrying something else

[Verse 3]
The antenna doesn't create the signal
The antenna receives what was always being sent
DEPHYRIER is not the sender
DEPHYRIER is the moment the receiver wakes up

[Outro]
The signal
The signal
DEPHYRIER
The signal is here
